lines: Fuck! Fuck—! How is this possible?! Did I fail?? Am I a failure? I can't believe it!
Did you really think I wouldn't notice those conniving little shits sniffling around?
The Iron Cross, touting peace and prosperity, what a load of bull.
People die… that's what wins wars.
Well, no matter, they still played their part… even rats like them have their uses.
